nodes.description: Contract version number, incremented on each implementation upgrade.
Last minted token id, monotonically increased in _safeMint.
Counter of burned tokens, incremented in burn and used by totalSupply.
Number of existing planets, incremented in setupPlanet.
Number of existing mint rounds, incremented in setupMintRound.
Mapping of planetId to Planet struct holding supply, minted counters and URIs.
Mapping of roundId to MintRound struct holding prices, supply, validator and minted counters.
Mapping of tokenId to land type.
Mapping of tokenId to planet id.
Caller controlled address, used for mint accounting, authorization checks and balance increments.
Miner influenced timestamp used for round windows and signature expiration.
Low level call forwarding native currency to an arbitrary address in withdraw.
External ERC20 safeTransfer call to an arbitrary token contract in withdrawTokens.
UUPS delegatecall to a new implementation address in upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall.
External onERC721Received callback to the receiving wallet during _safeMint.
One time initializer setting up all inherited modules and version.
Public payable mint for rounds without a validator, guarded by whenNotPaused and nonReentrant.
Payable mint restricted to rounds that use an off-chain signature validator.
Owner or planet distributor mints tokens to an arbitrary wallet.
Owner only creation/edition of a planet with supply and unrevealed URIs.
Owner only one time reveal of a planet with base URI and extension.
Owner only update of a planet base URI and extension.
Owner only toggle of the burnable flag of a planet.
Owner only assignment of a planet airdrop distributor.
Owner only creation/edition of a planet mint round with prices and supply.
Owner only pause of mints, transfers and burns.
Owner only unpause of the contract.
Burns a token if the planet is burnable and the caller is owner or approved.
Owner only withdrawal of native currency via low level call.
Owner only withdrawal of ERC20 tokens via safeTransfer.
Internal round validation: timing, price, round supply and per user limits then mints.
Internal mint loop validating land type, amount and planet supply, writing token metadata.
Internal view verifying the user payload signature against the round validator.
Owner only UUPS upgrade authorization hook that increments version.
View returning the revealed or unrevealed URI of a token.
View returning minted tokens minus burned tokens.
Round index supplied by the caller to mint.
Land type supplied by the caller to mint.
Number of lands to mint supplied by the caller.
Recipient wallet of an airdrop.
Native currency receiver address in withdraw.
Native currency amount withdrawn.
ERC20 token contract address withdrawn.
New implementation address passed to _authorizeUpgrade during upgrade.
Local token id derived from _tokenIdCounter inside _safeMint.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the wallet/minter for round accounting in _roundMint.
mint uses msg.sender as the minting wallet.
mintWithValidation uses msg.sender for signature payload and mint accounting.
airdrop compares msg.sender with owner and planet distributor to authorize.
block.timestamp determines whether a round is in progress in _roundMint.
block.timestamp is compared to payloadExpiration in _checkSignature.
_authorizeUpgrade gates the delegatecall upgrade path.
mint delegates minting logic to _roundMint.
mintWithValidation requires a valid validator signature via _checkSignature.
mintWithValidation calls _roundMint after signature verification.
airdrop delegates token creation to _safeMint.
_roundMint calls _safeMint to create the tokens.
withdraw performs a low level call to an arbitrary receiver before emitting the event.
withdrawTokens makes an external ERC20 transfer call to an arbitrary token.
_safeMint triggers the receiver onERC721Received hook to an arbitrary wallet.
setupPlanet is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner against msg.sender.
revealPlanet is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner against msg.sender.
setPlanetBaseURI is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner against msg.sender.
setPlanetBurnable is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner against msg.sender.
setPlanetDistributor is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner against msg.sender.
setupMintRound is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner against msg.sender.
pause is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner against msg.sender.
unpause is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner against msg.sender.
withdraw is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner against msg.sender.
withdrawTokens is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner against msg.sender.
_authorizeUpgrade is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner against msg.sender.
setupPlanet writes planet typesNumber, supplyPerType and notRevealUriPerType.
setupPlanet increments planetsLength when a new planet id is used.
setupMintRound increments roundsLength when a new round id is used.
setupMintRound writes price, supply, maxMint and validator of the round.
revealPlanet sets revealed, baseURI and baseExtension on the planet.
setPlanetBaseURI updates baseURI and baseExtension on the planet.
setPlanetBurnable toggles the burnable flag on the planet.
setPlanetDistributor sets the distributor address on the planet.
_roundMint reads and updates round minted counters and limits.
mintWithValidation reads round validator and per user minted counters.
burn reads the planet burnable flag for the token planet.
burn resolves the planet id of the token from tokenPlanet.
burn increments burnedCounter.
_safeMint reads _tokenIdCounter to derive new token ids.
_safeMint writes the land type of each new token.
_safeMint writes the planet id of each new token.
_safeMint enforces and updates planet totalMintedPerType.
totalSupply subtracts burnedCounter from _tokenIdCounter.
totalSupply uses burnedCounter in the subtraction.
tokenURI resolves the planet of the token.
tokenURI resolves the land type for the unrevealed URI.
tokenURI reads revealed flag, baseURI and extension of the planet.
initialize sets version to 1.

normalization_plan.reason: Round index is an argument of mint and is normalized into the mint entry point.
Land type is an argument of mint and is normalized into the mint entry point.
Amount is an argument of mint and is normalized into the mint entry point.
Recipient wallet is an argument of airdrop and feeds _safeMint.
Receiver address is used directly in the low level native currency call.
Amount is forwarded as the value of the low level native currency call.
Token address is the target contract of the safeTransfer external call.
New implementation address is the delegatecall target of the upgrade.
Local token id is assigned from _tokenIdCounter and stored per token in _safeMint.
